label: Spending windows a lender may cap a borrower to, and when to warn

params.name: total_hours
params.label: Hours in the 'total' window (0 = since the share began)

params.name: cap_max_usd
params.label: Largest cap a lender may type

params.name: warn_at_pct
params.label: Warn the borrower once this much of a window is used

params.name: windows
params.label: The windows, in the order the screen shows them

description_nl: day_hours, week_hours, month_hours: each cap is measured over a ROLLING window of this many hours back from now, which needs no time zone and no month length. cap_max_usd: the biggest number a lender may type into a cap box. warn_at_pct: the borrower is warned once this much of a window is used. windows: which windows exist and in what order they are shown. total_hours = 0 means the 'total' window is not rolling at all: it counts everything since the share began. That is how a BOUGHT key works - somebody pays for $10 of credit, so the only cap is the $10, and day, week and month are left at 0.
weight_basis: Rolling windows, not calendar ones: a cap is what was spent in the last N hours.
